meta.name: Mysteries Xplored: The Curse of Oak Island
meta.description:
Experience the world's greatest mysteries with some of the world’s greatest experts. William Shatner, Laurence Fishburne, Zachary Quinto, Giorgio A. Tsoukalos, the Lagina brothers and more take you on a 24/7 journey to uncover the truth.

Shows: The Curse of Oak Island, The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch, Strange Earth, Aliens, The Watchers
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
